sections.text_helper: Section 27.4.17 "AES initialization vector registers" in chapter 27 (AES hardware accelerator (AES)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 820.
sections.section_content:
The four AES_IVRx registers store the initialization vector (IV) information, as shown in
Table212. They can only be written if the AES peripheral is disabled (EN cleared).
Note: In memory and in AES IV registers, initialization vectors are stored in little-endian format,
with most significant byte on the highest address.
[Table 212. IVI bitfield spread over AES_IVRx registers]
Initialization vector information depends on the chaining mode selected. When used,
AES_IVRx registers are updated upon each AES computation cycle (useful for managing
suspend mode).
The initialization vector registers are not affected by the data swapping feature controlled
through DATATYPE[1:0].
